title: [review] receive.rs: u64 to u32 timestamp truncation
description: The now_ms parameter (u64) is cast to u32 when passed to staged.process(). Values exceeding u32::MAX (~49.7 days of milliseconds) wrap around, potentially causing incorrect announce freshness checks, premature expiration, or acceptance of stale announces. If now_ms represents Unix epoch milliseconds, truncation occurs immediately; if relative to boot, after ~50 days uptime.
